basic_info.description: This center patio home boasts one of the best ocean views from the Sunset/Parkside districts. Custom remodeled recently for owner use, but owners have to re-locate. This home features 4 master suites with ocean views up and down, movie room, spacious living room with fireplace, formal dining room, top of the line kitchen remodel with stainless steel appliances & beautiful custom cabinets, additional guest bedroom, family room, sound proofed floors, recessed lights, built-in ceiling speakers, built-in expresso maker, custom beautifully designed fish pond, semi-enclosed area in the yard with built-in benches for entertaining, lots of personal touches & high end finishes. Do not miss this one!
